boards.name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobbörse
boards.notes: The logo link reads zur Startseite der Bundesagentur für Arbeit, so the site is operated by the Bundesagentur für Arbeit. No language switcher was found on the fetched page. The /datenangebot page returned HTTP 404, so no API information was captured.

boards.name: LinkedIn Jobs
boards.notes: The language switcher lists 36 entries; the two Chinese variants are mapped to zh, giving 35 codes. Footer shows LinkedIn © 2026 and an About link; parent not stated on the page. developer.linkedin.com lists APIs with Create app and Apply now buttons, but does not say whether a key is required. Its only job-related text is a link labelled Job Posting API Terms Of Use. No employer pricing shown.

boards.name: Jobware
boards.notes: Footer names Jobware GmbH; no parent or headquarters stated on the pages read. No language switcher and no employer prices found. The employer page describes job ad products without prices and mentions a partner network of up to 532 partner platforms, a distribution network rather than a partner program for job boards. No API, XML feed or ATS integration mentioned on the pages read; developer pages were not read.

boards.name: kimeta
boards.notes: Employer page lists prices excluding VAT, with flatrate terms of 1 or 3 months and up to 20 percent term discount. No API, XML feed, ATS integration or partner program mentioned on the employer page. Parent and headquarters not stated on the pages read; Impressum and Über uns were not read.

boards.name: Berlin Startup Jobs
boards.notes: Parent not stated. A sister site for London is linked, and the relationship is not described. Developer, API and partner links on the homepage are skill-tag pages only. The basic package includes an email job alert listing and social posts.

sources.title: Job post prices
sources.quote: Receive up to 30% off when purchasing discounted job post packages in advance.
